messages:
emma (Design): quick microcopy check on the 'Export logs' empty state. current help text says: 'No logs yet. Export to see activity.' Feels ambiguous. :thinking_face:
chris (PM): users in tests wondered where exported logs go and if export runs automatically or starts a job. we should be clearer and give a next action.
rafa (Frontend): current CTA is a link-styled button 'Export'. it triggers a modal that collects range + format. the empty state copy is static though.
sam (a11y): small a11y nit: the empty state illustration lacks alt text; decorative? If decorative, mark aria-hidden. If conveys meaning (e.g., 'No logs'), provide an accessible label. Also the CTA should be descriptive (avoid single word 'Export').
emma (Design): proposed copy overhaul:
Heading: "No logs yet"
Body: "Export a log snapshot to download recent activity or create a recurring export job. You can choose time range and file format in the next step."
Primary CTA (button): "Export logs"
Secondary (link): "Schedule recurring export"
Alt/accessibility: decorative illustration aria-hidden; empty state container has aria-label 'No logs available'.
chris (PM): love it. adding the line about choosing range/format helps set expectations. Also add a small microcopy line for large exports: 'Large ranges may take several minutes to prepare.'
emma (Design): good call. add that as small helper text under CTA: "Note: large ranges may take several minutes to prepare."
rafa (Frontend): will update the component: set illustration aria-hidden, add aria-label on the container, change CTA text, and surface helper text. also will ensure the export modal reads the aria-label as context.
sam (a11y): confirm the CTA is a real <button> with accessible name 'Export logs' and not just a link. the schedule link should have clear accessible name including frequency examples in the panel. ensure focus lands in modal and returns after close. also add role="status" for the export job start notification so assistive tech hears it.\emmaa (Design): tiny typo: 'emmaa' meant 'emma' :sweat_smile:
chris (PM): haha. PR checklist: update copy table, update Figma empty state, add cypress test to assert CTA accessible name and that helper note appears for >7-day range.
design-bot: queued: update copy doc at https://figma.mock/redwood/empty-states by @emma.
rafa (Frontend): PR #4271 created, includes copy update, aria fixes, and test stubs. planning to deploy to canary after tests.
emma (Design): thanks — will review and add screenshots to the copy doc. tagging @sam for a11y review. :sparkles:
sam (a11y): will smoke test with VoiceOver/NVDA after canary. thanks team! :white_check_mark:
